descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Are you ready to manage, optimize, and secure mission-critical database environments for large-scale Identity & Biometrics solutions?
 If you enjoy working across multi-database ecosystems (Oracle, SQL Server, Open-Source DBs), ensuring high availability, and collaborating with international R&D teams, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.”
 📍 This role is hybrid with 3 days onsite in Bucharest ( includes travel opportunities across the Europe / Eurasia region) .
 🚀 First who? 
5+ years of experience in database administration across production and project delivery environments.
Solid hands-on expertise with Oracle, MySQL/MariaDB, and Microsoft SQL Server (PostgreSQL is an asset).
Strong knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows Server administration (CPU, memory, disk I/O, storage).
Practical experience in High Availability (HA), clustering, replication, and Disaster Recovery planning (RPO/RTO).
Solid grasp of database security: user access controls, TDE encryption, SSL/TLS, and CIS benchmark hardening.
Experience with capacity planning, SAN/NAS storage management, and performance diagnostics.
Ability to automate routine maintenance tasks using Shell scripting or DevOps tools.
Autonomous, decision-driven, and fluent in English with an openness to travel within Europe/Eurasia.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll ensure the performance, availability, and security of database solutions throughout their lifecycle.
You’ll collaborate closely with European Biometrics R&D teams (~50% of your time), delivery units, and support teams.
You’ll drive deployment automation, operational reliability, and disaster recovery readiness.
You’ll support on-site and remote customer implementations, migrations, and complex troubleshooting.
 📌 Your mission 
Install, configure, patch, and administer Oracle, MySQL/MariaDB, and SQL Server databases
Monitor database availability, health, growth, and capacity across delivery and live customer environments
Troubleshoot complex incidents, connectivity issues, and execute SQL/database performance tuning
Implement, test, and maintain backup/recovery strategies, clustering, replication, and DR procedures
Enforce database security controls, manage privileges, implement TDE, and execute hardening procedures
Automate deployments and repetitive operational tasks using scripting and DevOps practices
Author clear technical procedures, runbooks, and reflex sheets for supervision and support teams
Provide technical expertise and on-site support during customer deployments or operational escalations
 ⚙️ Your toolbox Technical Skills 
Relational DBs: Oracle, MySQL / MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL
OS Administration: Linux / UNIX & Windows Server
High Availability & DR: Clustering, Replication, Backup/Restore, RPO/RTO
Security & Hardening: TDE, SSL/TLS, Role-based Access, CIS Benchmarks
Storage & Infrastructure: Capacity Planning, SAN / NAS, I/O tuning
Scripting & Automation: Shell Scripting (Bash), PowerShell, DevOps tooling
Virtualization & Containers (Docker, Kubernetes, VMware) - plus
NoSQL & Data Streaming (Cassandra, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka) - plus
Networking Context (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Firewalls, VPN) - plus
 General Skills
Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving mindset
Customer-focused approach with excellent communication and stakeholder alignment
Ability to make sound technical decisions under pressure or uncertainty
Familiarity with Agile frameworks and ITIL concepts
Fluent command of English (mandatory)
Flexibility to travel for client/project requirements across Europe & Eurasia
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what?
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
